pages.text: The Hex Focus will be the tool used to trigger many events on the mod, currently, it is needed to trigger $(l:hexalia:rituals/ritual_of_transmutation)Rituals$() once all required items are placed.$(br2)It can be used to change the appearance of $(l:hexalia:brewing/brew_shelf)Brew Shelves$() and converting Deepslate into a $(l:hexalia:rituals/ritual_table)Ritual Table$().
